description: Railway-oriented programming for TypeScript: Result<T>, Maybe<T>, a rule engine, validation, resilience, idempotency and DDD base classes with async pipeline support.
rules: Import from the subpath of each module, for example tsentials/result or tsentials/idempotency; validation, resilience, pagination, enums, mediator and idempotency are not re-exported from the root entry.
Return Result<T> from operations that can fail and build failures with the Err factories (Err.validation, Err.notFound, Err.unexpected) instead of throwing.
Chain results with Result.then, not bind, and parse JSON with safeJsonParse instead of JSON.parse.
